hold_text: This PR adds research/queue/RQ-20260927-001.yaml as a NEW file (a pre-registered decision rule), which STAMP_ONLY_SURFACE and TIER1_SURFACE both correctly refuse to vouch for -- registering a decision rule is exactly the act R5/E57's own comment says must hold for a human ('a rule that can be rewritten and self-landed in the same act as the dispatcher's stamp is not pre-registered'). Every other changed path (research/results/**, docs/claude/work/pipeline/**, .github/**) is inside TIER1_SURFACE and would self-land cleanly on its own. This is Tier-1 research work -- no config/, src/, or live order-path file is touched, no exit-head artifact or gate was changed -- held only because the guard correctly cannot certify a brand-new decision-rule file as a stamp.
why: Genuine out-of-sample re-grade of exit-head-donchian-1h-v1 (RQ-20260927-001), addressing operator decision 2026-09-27 (MANAGER-CHECKLIST.json row R4 item (3): 'Re-run RQ-007 with a proper train/test split first'). Walk-forward retrain (embargoed split 2025-01-06T16:00:00Z) replayed on n=119 genuinely OOS BTCUSDT trades, clearing the pre-registered n>=64.07 power floor. Verdict: PASS, recovered_R_oos +1.3127 (small, +0.011R/trade, single split -- marginal support, not decisive). Lands one research/queue/*.yaml unit (new file, decision rule registered before the run), one research/results/RQ-20260927-001/*.jsonl record, and two docs/claude/work/pipeline/*.json state-change records (closes PI-20260926-96NDZSOD-0002; appends the result to PI-20260926-6M9R1WSA-0001). No config, artifact-stage, or live-path change; promotion itself stays Tier-3 and is NOT decided by this PR.
